pages.text: Activate a $(l:travel/waystones#waystone)Waystone$(/l) and you can return to it from any other. The farther you go, the more experience it costs.

A $(l:travel/waystones#waystone)Warp Stone$(/l) does the same from your pocket. $(l:travel/waystones#return_scroll)Return Scrolls$(/l) and $(l:travel/waystones#return_scroll)Warp Scrolls$(/l) are one-way tickets. $(l:travel/waystones#sharestone)Sharestones$(/l) only link to others of their colour.
Sharestones only link to other sharestones of the same colour.
